name: Natural medicine for diabetes
indication_description: This tablet is indicated in diabetes.
pharmacology_description: This tablet is a research product of Hamdard Laboratories. It is a proven unani formulation for diabetes. The main ingredient of this tablet is Gymnema (Gymnema sylvestre) is also called gurmar, which is a Hindi name meaning 'destroyer of sugar'. This tablet corrects the functions of pancreas & stimulates insulin secretion. It helps to block the absorption of sugar from gastrointestinal tract and maintains the normal blood sugar level.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) should be taken 30 minutes before meal twice daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Avoid sweet and excess carbohydrate containing foods. Keep out ofreach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
